title: Fast mode, rebuilt on the shared popup layout

steps.path: Chat → model chip in the status bar → Fast mode switch (Claude Code sessions)
steps.headline: Fast mode, rebuilt to match the other one-job popups. Which main button?
steps.notice: What changed in both new versions: one width with the other popups; the three bits of words that each said "it costs extra" are now one line, one warning box with the prices in normal type, and how to turn it off; the buttons stack with the main one on top. Title "Turn on Fast mode?" to match its button. Every fact is still there.

variants.label: Today
variants.summary: As it is now: narrower, buttons side by side, prices in code-style type with a line inside the box, a one-of-a-kind orange button.

variants.label: App's main button
variants.summary: The theme's normal main button, like every other popup. The yellow warning box carries the "this costs money" message. I recommend this one.
variants.risk: The button no longer looks different from a free action; only the box and the words "accept charges" warn you.

variants.label: Keep the orange
variants.summary: Same new layout, but the main button stays orange, as an extra money warning.
variants.risk: The only orange button in the app, and it ignores the theme's colours (it stays orange on every theme).
